# Session Handoff Commands

Bidirectional session management across OpenCode, Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot.

## Commands

### Claim Session for Claude Code

```bash
claude claim-session <session-id>
```

Recovers a Copilot or previous Claude Code session and resumes it in the current Claude Code session.

- Fetches transcript from unified queue
- Loads worktree/context
- Continues from last checkpoint

### Hand Off to OpenCode Batch

```bash
claude handoff-to-batch [--mode merge|review]
```

Transitions current session to batch worker for automated processing.

- `merge`: automatically merge changes (HIC approval required)
- `review`: MERGE_READY state, awaiting manual review

### Hand Off to Cursor

```bash
claude handoff-to-cursor <session-id> [--window]
```

Exports session to Cursor workspace.

- `--window`: open new VS Code window with context

### List Available Sessions

```bash
claude sessions list [--platform copilot|claude-code|opencode]
```

Show all recovered and active sessions.

### Session Status

```bash
claude session status <session-id>
```

Check current platform owner and state.

---

## Session State Machine

```
RECOVERED (in unified queue)
    ↓
CLAIMED (by platform: opencode|claude-code|cursor)
    ↓
IN_PROGRESS (active processing)
    ↓
HANDOFF_READY (awaiting next platform)
    ↓
DONE (merged or completed)
```

## Unified Queue Format

```jsonl
{
  "id": "copilot_deddef51",
  "platform": "copilot",
  "state": "RECOVERED",
  "title": "Fix PR 1851 and Merge",
  "branch": "kya-baseline-clean",
  "transcript_lines": 2463,
  "created_at": "2026-08-18T12:55:13.248Z",
  "last_activity": "2026-08-18T17:10:28.170Z",
  "claimed_by": null,
  "claimed_at": null,
  "handoff_ready": true
}
```
